name: QM9: Quantum Chemistry Structures and Properties of 134k Molecules
description: QM9 is a benchmark dataset in quantum chemistry and machine learning on molecular graphs. It contains 133,885 stable small organic molecules consisting of up to 9 heavy atoms (C, O, N, F) drawn from the GDB-17 chemical universe. For each molecule, geometric, thermodynamic, electronic, and energetic properties (19 physical properties including dipole moment, polarizability, HOMO, LUMO, and atomization energy) are calculated at the B3LYP/6-31G(2df,p) level of density functional theory.
